name: Cult Ambush
text: When this unit is destroyed, roll a D6 (+3 if BATTLELINE). On a 4+ it joins your Cult Ambush pool and you place a marker over 9 inches from all enemies. After your opponent's Reinforcements step, each marker returns one pooled unit at full strength via Deep Strike, touching it. Enemy models ending a move within 9 inches remove it. No returns in rounds 4-5.

name: Spiritual Leader
text: While this model leads a unit, every model in that unit has a 5+ Feel No Pain save against wounds caused by Psychic attacks.

name: Vile Insurrectionists
text: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, you may re-roll a hit roll of 1.

name: Vile Insurrectionists (objective)
text: If the target of the attack is within range of an objective marker, you may also re-roll a wound roll of 1.
